vectors.success: Both fixed native-source requests import, export byte-identically, return a node, and produce an edited document without mutating the input document.
vectors.errors: Schema proposeNodeEdit returns JSON_SCHEMA_POINTER / Invalid JSON Pointer before parsing malformed replacement text; a valid pointer then returns JSON_SCHEMA_SYNTAX. Unknown operations return REQUEST.
vectors.control: An invocation-local host-control rejection is returned through umf.core-wire/1 with its original code/message; resource setup and operation share the hook.
vectors.inspection: Schema inspection matches all five source-frozen diagnostic cases; table inspection matches three selected cases from the nine-case table warning receipt. Core differential tests cover all nine table cases.

limits: Opt-in JSON wire only; no Node, WASM, Python, CLI, SDK, or default-route binding is added.
Wire inspection differential covers five schema cases and three selected table warning cases; core differential tests cover all nine named table cases, without claiming exhaustive parity.
Table context does not reconcile Delta log actions or validate native reader/writer behavior.
